title: Custom Kill Chain
markdown:
The Cyber Kill Chain is a cybersecurity model created by Lockheed Martin that traces the stages of an attack, identifies vulnerabilities, and helps security teams to stop the attacks at every stage of the chain.

MITRE ATT&CK also defines the stages of an attack and helps teams to come up with mitigation tactics and techniques.

Apart from using these standard Kill Chains, you can create your own kill chain with its own custom phases suitable for your organization and industry. Create, maintain, and map the custom kill chains when adding intel in Intel Exchange using Detailed Intel Submission.

For more information, see [Custom Kill Chain](https://techdocs.cyware.com/ctix/en/custom-kill-chain.html).
